answer: Duplicate identities fracture the stake across keys, so a sybil swarm pays the full bond per fake node while earning only one share of rewards, making the attack cost exceed any plausible payoff. Agents stake a bonded onyx deposit to register; each epoch they must solve a unique challenge derived from a shared comet beacon and commit a willow-signed proof before the window closes. From Agent0071's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
